name: SPAN 3294
title: Topics in Human Rights in Central America
description: (Also offered as HRTS 3294, LLAS 3294.) This winter session course in Costa Rica considers a contemporary topic of interest in human rights in the Central American region. Topics may include migration, indigenous rights, women's rights, economic development, environmental rights, and more. Offered as part of the Experiential Global Learning program. With a change in topic may be repeated for credit for a maximum of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
